headline: Indian Stock Markets Rally as Sensex Surges and Nifty Crosses 25,300 Led by FII Inflows

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Surge in Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) inflows driving market optimism
Positive Q2 earnings results boosting overall investor confidence
Strong buying momentum across financial and auto sector stocks
Technical momentum pushing benchmark indices to multi-month highs
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 1,200 points to hit a nine-month high
Nifty 50 crossed key resistance levels of 25,250 and 25,300
MSCI November index rejig added Coforge, LIC, Adani Green, and Meesho
Systematix maintained 'Buy' rating on Data Patterns following Q2 review citing a record order book
summary: Indian equities staged a sharp rally with the Sensex jumping over 1,200 points and Nifty closing above 25,300. Strong FII inflows along with encouraging Q2 corporate results led the momentum, particularly in auto and banking shares. Key individual stock highlights include MSCI index inclusions and positive analyst calls on select stocks.
